extraction_notes: Maagar Mochot (Prof. Yitzhak Katz) for Channel 16, report dated 02/09/2026, 4 pages. Fieldwork listed as '1/8 1600-2400' and '2/9 0700-1500' - the '1/8' is evidently a typo for 1/9, so fieldwork recorded as 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-02. Method: combined internet panel with phone completions. Initial sample 550; 966 approached; 552 participated; response 57%; statistical error 4.2% at 95%. Stratified sampling + random within strata.
